name: design
description: Phase 2 (Design) worker — IN PROGRESS at v0.3.0: `help`, `init` and `overview` work; the other twelve commands in the design specification are declared-not-built and labelled as such in commands/help.md, so invoking one produces nothing rather than a guess. Turns the requirement spine produced by `req` into two renderings of one truth: a Thai narrative document a client can sign, and structured JSON downstream plugin agents act on without asking a clarifying question. Reads req through scripts/req-contract.mjs, the single place that knows the shape of req output, and HALTS with exit 2 naming the path it looked for when a mandatory input is absent or malformed rather than inferring it. Judgement stays with the owner and arithmetic stays with the scripts: a command never invents scope or constraints, it validates that they were written down and renders what they say. Generated documents are never hand-edited and carry no edit-here markers — refinement happens upstream in the JSON, so a regeneration can never silently eat someone work. Ownership is per file, never per folder: no JSON is written by two plugins even for disjoint fields, so the trace graph is split by author and joined at read time by ID. Every command is idempotent, reads design.state.json before acting, and writes nothing without --write.
